messages:
alex (Recruiter): Quick heads-up : Candidate Lina R (Senior PM) — currently UK-based contractor — verbal acceptance pending. Hiring team proposing base $155,000 + $8k sign-on + standard equity. Our US L2 band top is $140k, so this is above-band. Candidate requested a June 1 start to maintain benefits continuity. Deadline for counteroffer is 2026-05-22. Can we route an exception?

mona (People Ops): Need to know if role will be UK-remote permanently or targeted for US relocation. Cross-border policy: above-band US pay for UK-headquartered employees needs exception and payroll plan. Also, conversions from contractor require documentation on prior invoices if any retention payments are proposed.

samir (Hiring Manager): Plan is to sponsor relocation but realistically it'll be Q4. We want to hire remote-UK initially on a US-targeted band because role overlaps heavily with US product team. The market says $155k is necessary to close. Asks: can comp committee approve above-band now with contingency for relocation payroll transfer?

rachel (Finance): If we approve US-band pay while employee is on UK payroll, we create tax and withholding complications. Finance prefers two options: 1) approve above-band in principle but pay a UK-localized equivalent until payroll transfer; or 2) approve sign-on now and defer base increase until payroll move. Either way, document effect on headcount budget.

jared (Legal): Visa timeline for a UK->US move will likely exceed 3-6 months for H-1 or work visa. Recommend offering UK-localized base now with written relocation support and a conditional US-base uplift upon payroll transfer. Also confirm contractor-to-employee IP assignment prior to start.

hr-bot: Automated: Comp exception ticket created CE-2026-099. Required attachments: offer draft, manager justification, contractor invoices, relocation plan. SLA: 48 business hours.

alex (Recruiter): Offer draft uploaded (link: drive.redwood/offers/lina_r_draft.pdf). Candidate flexible on start between 5/20 and 6/1 but wants pay assurance. Willing to sign with conditional language around relocation bump.

mona (People Ops): Routing to comp chair (olivia). Proposed decision choices for committee: A) Approve full US pay now (exception) contingent on payroll/legal checklist; B) Approve sign-on + hire at UK-equivalent band now, with guaranteed US bump upon relocation; C) Decline above-band. Please react with :a: for A, :b: for B, :c: for C or reply with notes.

olivia (Comp Chair): Reviewing CE-2026-099. Given payroll and legal risk, leaning to option B (sign-on + UK band + guaranteed relocation uplift). This balances candidate expectations and compliance. Will confirm final decision in 24 hours.

samir (Hiring Manager): :thumbsup: to option B. Can we guarantee a relocation uplift in writing? Candidate needs a clear trigger (payroll transfer + work authorization approved).

rachel (Finance): We can sign off on a conditional uplift clause: "upon successful payroll transfer to US and completion of relocation, base salary will be adjusted to $155,000". Finance to confirm exact proration and effective date once relocation processed.

jared (Legal): Will draft conditional uplift clause and relocation addendum. Also: no retroactive salary for contractor period; conversion bonus only, if approved, will be taxed as ordinary income.

alex (Recruiter): I'll present option B language to Lina now and request reply by EOD to keep her from accepting other offers. Thanks everyone.

olivia (Comp Chair): Final decision: CE-2026-099 APPROVED per option B. Terms: base salary set at UK-equivalent band on hire; one-time sign-on $8,000 payable after start; guaranteed written uplift to $155,000 upon payroll transfer to US and completion of relocation; conditions: legal and payroll checklists completed, contractor invoices attached, no retroactive pay. Ticket closed pending final offer acceptance.

hr-bot: Automated: CE-2026-099 status updated: APPROVED. Please attach signed offer to ticket and confirm start date.

alex (Recruiter): Candidate accepted conditional offer verbally and requested 2026-06-01 start. I'll upload signed docs when received and mark CE ticket closed.
